traits.name: Approval
traits.effect: This Soldier Type requires GM approval due to its espionage and deception potential.

traits.name: Hidden
traits.effect: May mask themselves as Army, Marine, Air Force, or Navy. Player and Character do not need to reveal their identity or motives.

traits.name: Rank
traits.effect: Begins at Rank O-1 and may take the Command Specialization Package even if another Character already has it.

traits.name: False Rank
traits.effect: Operative receives pay of their true Rank but displays a false Rank to maintain cover.

traits.name: Support
traits.effect: Gains +1 Support Point at Character Creation and after each Mission. This bonus does not regenerate after use.

traits.name: UNSC Gear Discount
traits.effect: All UNSC gear costs half cR for the ONI Operative.

traits.name: Squad Up
traits.effect: +5 Courage and +10 Warfare Melee/Range when taking Combined Actions with Army, Marine, Air Force, Navy, ORION, ODST, Militiaman, or Spartan IV Soldier Types.

insurrectionist_rules.weapon_cost_increase: Weapons without the [I] tag cost 25% more.
insurrectionist_rules.modification_discount: Weapon and Vehicle Modifications cost half cR.

special_rules.description: ONI Section I is the intelligence-gathering branch of ONI, specializing in espionage, codebreaking, and covert operations.

evacuate.effect: May spend 1 Support Point to call in a falsified evacuation of any urban or colonial location.
evacuate.legitimate_evacuations: If the evacuation is legitimate for civilian survival, it is free.

espionage.effect: May remove any intel sent to the party before others see it and may replace it with falsified documents.

provision.effect: May call in Army, Marine, Navy, and Air Force Infantry Support at half cost. May call in Ordnance at 1/4 cost.
